FastShipB1FOnDutySailorText:
Hey, kid. Could I
get you to look for my buddy?

He's goofing off
somewhere, that lazy bum!

I want to go find
him, but I'm on duty right now.
FastShipB1FOnDutySailorRefusedText:
Oh, gee…

The CAPTAIN will
be furious…
FastShipB1FOnDutySailorThanksText:
Thanks, kid!
I chewed him out

good so he'll quit
slacking off!
FastShipB1FOnDutySailorSawLittleGirlText:
A little girl?

I may have seen
her go by here.
FastShipB1FOnDutySailorDirectionsText:
The dining room is
up ahead.

The stairs at the
end lead to the CAPTAIN's cabin.
SailorJeffSeenText:
Nothing beats a
battle when I'm on my break.
SailorJeffBeatenText:
Win or lose, my
break's over!
SailorJeffAfterBattleText:
I guess I can't
win if I don't get serious.
PicnickerDebraSeenText:
I'm so bored.
Want to battle?
PicnickerDebraAfterBattleText:
SAFFRON, CELADON…
I hear there are

many big cities
in KANTO.
JugglerFritzAfterBattleText:
No more ships for
me. Next time,

I'm taking the
MAGNET TRAIN.
SailorGarrettSeenText:
This is where we
sailors work!
SailorGarrettBeatenText:
I lost on my home
field…
SailorGarrettAfterBattleText:
We get different
passengers from

VERMILION CITY to
OLIVINE CITY.
FisherJonahSeenText:
Even though we're
out on the sea, I can't fish!

This is boring!
Let's battle!
FisherJonahAfterBattleText:
I plan to fish off
VERMILION's pier.
BlackbeltWaiSeenText:
I'm building up my
legs by bracing

against the ship's
rocking!
BlackbeltWaiAfterBattleText:
I couldn't find
the KARATE KING in JOHTO.

He's supposed to
be training in a cave somewhere.
SailorKennethSeenText:
I'm a sailor man!

But I'm training
#MON, so I can become the CHAMP!
SailorKennethBeatenText:
My lack of train-
ing is obvious…
SailorKennethAfterBattleText:
Eight BADGES!
They must prove

that you've beaten
GYM LEADERS.

No wonder you're
so good!
TeacherShirleySeenText:
Don't lay a finger
on my students!
TeacherShirleyAfterBattleText:
We're on a field
trip to the RUINS outside VIOLET.
SchoolboyNateSeenText:
Do you know the
RUINS OF ALPH?
SchoolboyNateAfterBattleText:
Radios pick up
strange signals inside the RUINS.
SchoolboyRickySeenText:
There are some odd
stone panels in the RUINS OF ALPH.
SchoolboyRickyAfterBattleText:
I read that there
are four of those stone panels.
